content: Our strength grows out of our weakness. The indignation which arms itself with secret forces does not awaken until we are pricked and stung.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Vulnerability and defeat are the catalysts that awaken dormant reserves of courage and ingenuity that comfortable ease would never summon.
practicalInsight: Do not hide from your vulnerabilities; let your struggles summon your deepest resilience and resourcefulness.
reflectionPrompt: How has a past defeat or vulnerability ended up forging your greatest strength?
